review_type: Independent AI-assisted source-text adjudication; NOT human adjudication.
blinding: Source papers/texts and the manuscript coding rule only. No coverage matrix, parameter vector, duplicate-pair audit-frame stratum, or matrix Hamming value was inspected.
coding_rule: same = identical examined-parameter suite; different = at least one parameter differs; undecidable = source does not support a decision.

scenario_identity_ambiguities.issue: Annual/summer/winter labels are analyst-derived views of the monthly Puerto Cuatreros series; annual metal results are pooled rather than seasonal.
Low-DO/high-NH3 zones and N:P/BFS management are analytic groupings of one pond dataset, not independently labeled sampling campaigns; the BFS pair is undecidable.
Water quality is reported only as a general pond-wide range, not by cultivation depth; the 20-cm versus 60-cm pair is therefore undecidable.
Table 4 does not separately report Cd-only tank-water chemistry; the Cd-only versus combined-water pair is therefore undecidable.
The n=40 creek row and neap/spring row refer to the same creek effort at different aggregations; other rows are distinct sampling scales.
